resources.string: Your safe sanctuary for reflection and emotional wellbeing.
Write how you are feeling today…
SafeDiary AI is a reflective companion and does not replace care from a licensed mental health professional.
What is on your mind today? I am here to listen and accompany you without judgment.
An error occurred while processing your message. Please try again.
I feel a bit overwhelmed today
I had a good day and want to log it
How can I practice calm breathing right now?

string-array.name: ai_responses_anxiety
string-array.item: I understand you are feeling anxious or overwhelmed right now. Remember to take a slow, deep breath: inhale for 4 seconds, exhale gently. I am here with you.
Anxiety can feel heavy, but you are not alone. What thought or situation feels like it is triggering this pressure today?
It is completely normal to feel overwhelmed at times. Take a one-minute pause; your emotions are valid and safe here.

string-array.name: ai_responses_sadness
string-array.item: I am so sorry you are going through this difficult moment. Allow yourself to feel without judgment; every day brings a different pace.
Sometimes the heart just needs a calm, quiet place to be heard. I am here with you—pour out whatever you are holding inside.
Acknowledging sadness is an act of courage. Would you like to explore what thought or memory is weighing most on you?

string-array.name: ai_responses_sleep
string-array.item: Restful sleep deeply shapes our emotional wellbeing. Try disconnecting from screens and gently release any tension in your shoulders.
If sleep is hard to find or your mind is racing, writing down your thoughts right now can help leave them on the page until tomorrow.

string-array.name: ai_responses_generic
string-array.item: Thank you for sharing this with me. Naming your feelings is the first step to processing them clearly. How does putting this into words feel right now?
I hear you attentively. Each reflection in your diary is an opportunity to connect with yourself honestly and without judgment.
I understand your perspective. Take all the time you need; SafeDiary is your safe sanctuary to release your thoughts.
